name: Sub Scribe
description: Sub Scribe brings subtitles to Jellyfin from SubDL.com and tvsubtitles.net: it downloads what is missing and uploads your own. Each source has its own switches, nothing goes back to the other source, the order is yours. A TMDb API Key is required, SubDL is optional. Created by AI under the directions of the maintainer.
overview: Sync subtitles with SubDL and tvsubtitles.net — download missing and upload new subtitles.

versions.changelog: v12.3.8.3: the source cards stay lean — no address field (the URL lives in the build), one short capability line instead of badges, and a secret field that looks filled and is typeable.
